import urllib.request, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, datetime as dt
feeds = {
 'CoinDesk':'https://www.coindesk.com/arc/outboundfeeds/rss/',

 'GoogleNews':'https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=bitcoin+crypto&hl=en-US&gl=US&ceid=US:en'
}
for name,u in feeds.items():
    print(f'\n## {name}')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(u, timeout=15) as r:
            xml = r.read()
        root = ET.fromstring(xml)
        items = root.findall('.//item')[:12]
        for i,it in enumerate(items,1):
            title = (it.findtext('title') or '').strip().replace('\n',' ')
            link = (it.findtext('link') or '').strip()
            pub = (it.findtext('pubDate') or '').strip()
            print(f'{i}. {pub} | {title} | {link}')
    except Exception as e:
        print('ERROR',e)
